results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if bot auth/connection is uncertain or after any 401)] [Prerequisite]: Validate readiness using DISCORDBOT_TEST_AUTH (stop if data.auth_ok is false or data.status_code=401).
[Optional (if server context is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Discover/select a server using DISCORD_LIST_MY_GUILDS (paginate with after/limit and tolerate nested results).
[Required (if destination channel identifier is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Enumerate candidate channels using DISCORDBOT_LIST_GUILD_CHANNELS (choose a message-capable text channel).
[Optional (if channel identifier is user-provided, stale, or permissions/type are uncertain)] [Prerequisite]: Validate channel accessibility using DISCORDBOT_GET_CHANNEL.
[Required (before any public write)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm destination plus final content/embeds and use conservative allowed_mentions for DISCORDBOT_CREATE_MESSAGE.
[Required] [Step]: Post using DISCORDBOT_CREATE_MESSAGE (include channel_id and at least one of content/embeds/components/sticker_ids).

[Optional (if DISCORDBOT_CREATE_MESSAGE fails and webhook posting is acceptable)] [Fallback]: Create then deliver via DISCORDBOT_CREATE_WEBHOOK and DISCORDBOT_EXECUTE_WEBHOOK (honor any Retry-After before retrying).
known_pitfalls: [DISCORDBOT_TEST_AUTH] Can succeed transport-wise but still be unauthorized (data.auth_ok=false with data.status_code=401); treat as a hard stop for writes.
[DISCORD_LIST_MY_GUILDS] Can error with no-active-connection (code 4302) and may return nested lists (for example under data.guilds).
[DISCORDBOT_LIST_GUILD_CHANNELS] Can return 401 or 403 Missing Access (Discord code 50001) and includes non-postable channel types.
[DISCORDBOT_CREATE_MESSAGE] Common failures: 403 (code 50013), 404 (code 10003), and 400/50035 when content exceeds ~2000 chars; respect rate limits via Retry-After.
[DISCORDBOT_EXECUTE_WEBHOOK] Can fail with 404 (code 10015) and requires at least one of content/embeds/attachments/poll; treat webhook_token as a secret and avoid emitting it.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Parse a potentially nested server list result from DISCORD_LIST_MY_GUILDS without assuming one response shape.
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
res,err=run_composio_tool("DISCORD_LIST_MY_GUILDS",{"limit":200})
data=(res or {}).get("data") or {}
items=(data.get("guilds") or data.get("details") or []) if isinstance(data,dict) else (data if isinstance(data,list) else [])
guilds=[g for g in items if isinstance(g,dict)]
```

DISCORDBOT_CREATE_MESSAGE.description: Sends a message to a Discord channel. Supports text content, embeds, stickers, components, and replies. Requires SEND_MESSAGES permission and at least one of content, embeds, sticker_ids, or components.

tts.description: Whether this is a text-to-speech message.

flags.description: Message flags (e.g., 4 for SUPPRESS_EMBEDS, 64 for EPHEMERAL).

embeds.description: Up to 10 embed objects. Each embed can contain title, description, url, timestamp, color, footer, image, thumbnail, video, provider, author, and fields.

content.description: Message text content (max 2000 characters). Required if embeds, sticker_ids, and components are all empty.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel to send the message to.

components.description: Up to 5 action rows of interactive components (buttons, select menus).

sticker_ids.description: Up to 3 sticker IDs accessible to the bot.

allowed_mentions.description: Controls which mentions in content trigger notifications. Keys: parse (list of 'roles', 'users', 'everyone'), roles (list of role IDs), users (list of user IDs), replied_user (bool).

message_reference.description: Reference for replying to a message. Requires message_id. Optional: channel_id, guild_id, fail_if_not_exists.

DISCORDBOT_LIST_GUILD_CHANNELS.description: Fetches all channels (text, voice, category, etc.) for a specified Discord guild. Does not include threads or message content.

guild_id.description: Identifier of the Discord guild (server) whose channels to list.

DISCORD_LIST_MY_GUILDS.description: Lists the current user's guilds, returning partial data for each; primarily used for displaying server lists or verifying memberships.

after.description: Get guilds after this guild ID.

limit.description: Max number of guilds to return (1-200, default 200).

before.description: Get guilds before this guild ID.

with_counts.description: Include approximate member and presence counts for each guild.
